name: Tolland County, CT
findings: Tolland County has 473 nonprofit organizations. 238 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 209 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Tolland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Tolland County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
